'''2012 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Mike Richards LS Yavin 4 (V)''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Mike Richards]] at [[2012 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Yavin 4 (V) (Virtual Block 7)|Yavin 4 (V)]]
* '''Username:''' mr007agent
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
